artifacts.summary: Recommends reusing deploy-freshness-lib.sh's existing deploy_freshness_status unchanged, adding a new git-tracked known-consumer-repos registry, a new check-consumer-freshness.sh reporting script with a --discover reconciliation mode, a hook in deploy-headless.sh naming stale consumers after each deploy, and a bounded non-blocking consecutive-ignore escalation on the existing per-repo tier-1 warning. Measured 8 live consumer repos on this machine today (2 more than the task delegation named). Flags that the declared file_scope needs widening to include two new files.

memory_candidates.content: deploy-freshness-lib.sh's deploy_freshness_status(repo_root, extension_name) is already repo-root-parametric: since the value it compares (source_dir) is an absolute path back into the source-store repo, the function works unmodified when called against ANY consumer repo's path, not just $(pwd)/$PROJECT_ROOT. A cross-repo fleet staleness report needs only a new enumeration+reporting layer on top of this existing primitive, never a new comparison algorithm.

This machine has 8 live consumer repos of ~/.config/nvim's agent-system source store, spread across three unrelated root directories (~/.dotfiles, ~/Projects/**, ~/Philosophy/Papers/**): .dotfiles, Projects/{BimodalLogic,ModelChecker,PersonalWebsite,cslib}, Projects/Logos/{Theory,Hardware}, Philosophy/Papers/PossibleWorlds. Discoverable via: find /home -maxdepth 6 -name .claude-extensions.json, filtered on core.source_dir matching this repo's agent-system/extensions/core path.
